items.title: File Einspruch against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Dieser Bescheid kann mit dem Einspruch angefochten werden. Die Einspruchsfrist beträgt einen Monat und rechnet ab der Bekanntgabe; ein Bescheid, der als Brief verschickt wird, ist am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden als bekannt gegeben anzusehen.
items.computation: Letter is dated Wed 18.11.2026 (posting day). Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 18.11.2026 + 4 days = Sun 22.11.2026. Since that falls on a Sunday, delivery is deemed to occur on the next working day, Mon 23.11.2026 (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO). Under § 108 Abs. 1 AO / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the one-month Einspruchsfrist (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) starts running on 24.11.2026 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day it started counting from the delivery date, i.e. one month after 23.11.2026 = Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a working day in Saarland, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: The letter states a tax refund (Guthaben) of 665,00 € will be paid to IBAN DE14 5139 0000 0074 4022 18 — this IBAN is well-formed but belongs to a private bank account (not the tax office's own account); the person should double-check this is indeed their own correct bank account, since any mismatch or change of account details on a letter should always be independently verified.

The Finanzamt's own payment account is given as IBAN DE95 5900 0000 0005 2003 00 — this is only relevant if the person owes money; here a credit (Guthaben) is being paid out to the person, not requested from them, so no payment by the recipient is due.
